picture.alt: A sunny riverbank under a willow tree. An old man with a long grey beard and grey hair in a topknot, in a mustard-yellow robe, sits on a low stone wall with one hand on his chin, smiling and listening. A young man in a dark teal robe leans in behind him. On the left a child in a blue robe, hair in a bun with a red ribbon, talks with both hands open; on the right a child in a rust-red robe stands talking and points up at the bright sun in the top right corner. Behind them a grey stone arch bridge crosses the river, and a small covered wooden boat is tied to a post in the water near the bridge, with nobody on it.

prompt.simplified: 穿红衣服的小朋友在做什么？

prompt.english: What is the child in red doing?

choices.traditional: 他一邊說話，一邊指著太陽。
choices.simplified: 他一边说话，一边指着太阳。
choices.pinyin: Tā yìbiān shuōhuà, yìbiān zhǐ zhe tàiyáng.
choices.english: He is talking and pointing at the sun.

choices.traditional: 他一邊說話，一邊指著船。
choices.simplified: 他一边说话，一边指着船。
choices.pinyin: Tā yìbiān shuōhuà, yìbiān zhǐ zhe chuán.
choices.english: He is talking and pointing at the boat.

questions.why: The bridge and the boat are behind the child. His hand points up toward the sun.

picture.alt: Inside an old hall with red pillars, open to a courtyard with grey tiled roofs; the leaves of a big green tree fill the top of the picture. At the left end of a long dark wooden table sits an old man with a long grey beard and grey hair in a topknot tied with a blue ribbon, in a mustard-yellow robe; he smiles and talks with both hands open towards the others, looking at them, not at the table. An unrolled bamboo scroll lies on the table; nobody is reading it, holding a brush or writing. Facing him at the table sit three listeners, each with a hand at the chin: a man with a black beard in a teal robe, a smiling child in a brown robe, and a young woman with long black hair in a pink robe.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 坐在老先生對面的三個人在做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 坐在老先生对面的三个人在做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zuò zài lǎo xiānshēng duìmiàn de sān ge rén zài zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What are the three people sitting across from the old man doing?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tāmen zài wèn lǎo xiānshēng wèntí.
choices.english: They are asking the older man questions.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tāmen zài kàn zhuōzi shàng de shū.
choices.english: They are looking at the book on the table.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們在認真地聽老先生說話。
choices.simplified: 他们在认真地听老先生说话。
choices.pinyin: Tāmen zài rènzhēn de tīng lǎo xiānshēng shuōhuà.
choices.english: They are listening carefully to the older man.

questions.why: The older man is speaking with his hands open. The three people look at him with their hands at their chins. The scroll is in front of them.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你怎麼這麼高興？
lines.simplified: 你怎么这么高兴？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme zhème gāoxìng?
lines.english: Why are you so happy?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我剛才在捷運上遇到我小學的老師。我們十五年沒見了，我以為她早就不記得我了。
lines.simplified: 我刚才在捷运上遇到我小学的老师。我们十五年没见了，我以为她早就不记得我了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gāngcái zài jiéyùn shàng yùdào wǒ xiǎoxué de lǎoshī. Wǒmen shíwǔ nián méi jiàn le, wǒ yǐwéi tā zǎo jiù bú jìdé wǒ le.
lines.english: I just ran into my primary-school teacher on the MRT. We hadn't seen each other for fifteen years, and I thought she'd long forgotten me.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 後來呢？
lines.simplified: 后来呢？
lines.pinyin: Hòulái ne?
lines.english: What happened next?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 誰知道她一看到我，就叫出了我的名字，還說我以前上課最愛跟同學吵架。
lines.simplified: 谁知道她一看到我，就叫出了我的名字，还说我以前上课最爱跟同学吵架。
lines.pinyin: Shéi zhīdào tā yí kàndào wǒ, jiù jiào chū le wǒ de míngzi, hái shuō wǒ yǐqián shàngkè zuì ài gēn tóngxué chǎojià.
lines.english: Who would have thought: the moment she saw me she called out my name, and she even said I used to love arguing with classmates in class.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼這麼高興？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么这么高兴？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme zhème gāoxìng?
prompt.english: Why is the man so happy?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Lǎoshī hái zhīdào tā shì shéi.
choices.english: His teacher still knew who he was.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng qǐ le lǎoshī de míngzi.
choices.english: He remembered his teacher's name.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老師說他以前很有禮貌
choices.simplified: 老师说他以前很有礼貌
choices.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō tā yǐqián hěn yǒu lǐmào.
choices.english: His teacher said he used to be very polite.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他每天都在捷運上遇到老師
choices.simplified: 他每天都在捷运上遇到老师
choices.pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu zài jiéyùn shàng yùdào lǎoshī.
choices.english: He meets his teacher on the MRT every day.

questions.why: He expected her to have forgotten him after fifteen years, but 誰知道 brings in the surprise: she called out his name at once. She is the one who remembered a name, and what she remembered was his arguing in class, not good manners.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你們換了一位教歷史的老師，他怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 听说你们换了一位教历史的老师，他怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐmen huàn le yí wèi jiāo lìshǐ de lǎoshī, tā zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: I hear you've got a new history teacher. What's he like?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我本來以為他年紀大，想法一定很保守，誰知道他上課都讓我們自己找問題討論。
lines.simplified: 我本来以为他年纪大，想法一定很保守，谁知道他上课都让我们自己找问题讨论。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái yǐwéi tā niánjì dà, xiǎngfǎ yídìng hěn bǎoshǒu, shéi zhīdào tā shàngkè dōu ràng wǒmen zìjǐ zhǎo wèntí tǎolùn.
lines.english: I thought that since he's older his ideas would be really conservative. Who knew he'd have us find our own questions to discuss in every class.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 討論什麼問題？
lines.simplified: 讨论什么问题？
lines.pinyin: Tǎolùn shénme wèntí?
lines.english: What kind of questions?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 像是古代南方人跟北方人，為什麼吃的東西不一樣。雖然比以前累，可是有意思多了。
lines.simplified: 像是古代南方人跟北方人，为什么吃的东西不一样。虽然比以前累，可是有意思多了。
lines.pinyin: Xiàng shì gǔdài nánfāng rén gēn běifāng rén, wèishénme chī de dōngxi bù yíyàng. Suīrán bǐ yǐqián lèi, kěshì yǒu yìsi duō le.
lines.english: Like why people in the south and the north ate different things in ancient times. It is more tiring than before, but much more interesting.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得新老師怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得新老师怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde xīn lǎoshī zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the man think of the new teacher?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhǐ jiāo dàjiā yǐqián chī shénme.
choices.english: He only teaches what people used to eat.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiāo de bǐ tā xiǎng de yǒu yìsi.
choices.english: He makes class more interesting than expected.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shàngkè de fāngfǎ hěn bǎoshǒu.
choices.english: He teaches in a conservative way.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shàng tā de kè bǐ yǐqián qīngsōng.
choices.english: His class is easier than the old one.

questions.why: He expected a conservative teacher, but the students find their own questions to discuss. The man finds class harder work than before, yet more interesting.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你們班那個小朋友今天又哭了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你们班那个小朋友今天又哭了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen bān nàge xiǎopéngyǒu jīntiān yòu kū le ma?
lines.english: Did that child in your class cry again today?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊，他常常說哭就哭。今天別的小朋友只是推了他一下，他就哭了半天。
lines.simplified: 对啊，他常常说哭就哭。今天别的小朋友只是推了他一下，他就哭了半天。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, tā chángcháng shuō kū jiù kū. Jīntiān bié de xiǎopéngyǒu zhǐshì tuī le tā yíxià, tā jiù kū le bàntiān.
lines.english: Yes, he often bursts into tears just like that. Today another child only gave him a little push, and he cried for ages.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他們沒有打架吧？
lines.simplified: 他们没有打架吧？
lines.pinyin: Tāmen méiyǒu dǎjià ba?
lines.english: They didn't fight, did they?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 沒有。我讓推他的小朋友跟他說對不起，後來他們又一起玩了。
lines.simplified: 没有。我让推他的小朋友跟他说对不起，后来他们又一起玩了。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu. Wǒ ràng tuī tā de xiǎopéngyǒu gēn tā shuō duìbùqǐ, hòulái tāmen yòu yìqǐ wán le.
lines.english: No. I had the child who pushed him say sorry, and afterwards they played together again.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 兩個小朋友怎麼又一起玩了？
prompt.simplified: 两个小朋友怎么又一起玩了？
prompt.pinyin: Liǎng ge xiǎopéngyǒu zěnme yòu yìqǐ wán le?
prompt.english: How did the two children end up playing together again?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 哭的小朋友先說對不起
choices.simplified: 哭的小朋友先说对不起
choices.pinyin: Kū de xiǎopéngyǒu xiān shuō duìbùqǐ.
choices.english: The child who cried apologized first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de qǐng tāmen xiān fēnkāi wán.
choices.english: The man asked them to play apart for a while.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 男的請推人的孩子說對不起
choices.simplified: 男的请推人的孩子说对不起
choices.pinyin: Nán de qǐng tuī rén de háizi shuō duìbùqǐ.
choices.english: The man asked the child who pushed to apologize.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 推人的孩子去找別人幫忙
choices.simplified: 推人的孩子去找别人帮忙
choices.pinyin: Tuī rén de háizi qù zhǎo biérén bāngmáng.
choices.english: The child who pushed went to get help.

questions.why: The child who cried was the one who got pushed. The man asked the other child to apologize, and they played together again afterwards.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 今天好熱，聽說下午會到三十五度。
lines.simplified: 今天好热，听说下午会到三十五度。
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān hǎo rè, tīngshuō xiàwǔ huì dào sānshíwǔ dù.
lines.english: It's so hot today. I hear it'll reach thirty-five degrees this afternoon.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那我們去山上吧！山上溫度比較低，河邊那座老橋下面感覺更涼快。
lines.simplified: 那我们去山上吧！山上温度比较低，河边那座老桥下面感觉更凉快。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen qù shān shàng ba! Shān shàng wēndù bǐjiào dī, hébiān nà zuò lǎo qiáo xiàmiàn gǎnjué gèng liángkuài.
lines.english: Then let's go up the mountain! It's cooler up there, and under the old bridge by the river it feels even cooler.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 現在嗎？我本來想等晚上不那麼熱再出門。
lines.simplified: 现在吗？我本来想等晚上不那么热再出门。
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài ma? Wǒ běnlái xiǎng děng wǎnshàng bú nàme rè zài chūmén.
lines.english: Now? I was going to wait until the evening, when it is not so hot, to go out.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 山上現在就很舒服啊，說走就走吧！
lines.simplified: 山上现在就很舒服啊，说走就走吧！
lines.pinyin: Shān shàng xiànzài jiù hěn shūfú a, shuō zǒu jiù zǒu ba!
lines.english: It's lovely up there right now. Let's just go!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧，不過我得先回家換衣服，我們一點在捷運站見。
lines.simplified: 好吧，不过我得先回家换衣服，我们一点在捷运站见。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, búguò wǒ děi xiān huí jiā huàn yīfú, wǒmen yī diǎn zài jiéyùn zhàn jiàn.
lines.english: All right, but I have to go home and change first. Let's meet at the MRT station at one.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們什麼時候出門？
prompt.simplified: 他们什么时候出门？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen shénme shíhòu chūmén?
prompt.english: When will they set off?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiànzài mǎshàng chūmén.
choices.english: Right now.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Wǎnshàng bú rè de shíhòu.
choices.english: In the evening, when it is not hot.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de huí jiā yǐhòu.
choices.english: After the man goes home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de huàn hǎo yīfú yǐhòu.
choices.english: After the woman has changed her clothes.

questions.why: 說走就走 is the man urging them to leave this minute, but the woman agrees only after she has gone home to change: they meet at one. Waiting for the evening was her first idea, which she drops, and it is she, not the man, who goes home.

focus.en: to go the moment you say so

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳今天看起來好累，昨天沒睡好嗎？
lines.simplified: 你今天看起来好累，昨天没睡好吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái hǎo lèi, zuótiān méi shuì hǎo ma?
lines.english: You look exhausted today. Didn't you sleep well last night?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我昨天加班到十一點，回家以後還幫弟弟複習數學。
lines.simplified: 我昨天加班到十一点，回家以后还帮弟弟复习数学。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān jiābān dào shíyī diǎn, huí jiā yǐhòu hái bāng dìdi fùxí shùxué.
lines.english: I worked overtime until eleven yesterday, and after I got home I helped my brother review maths.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 難怪妳剛才上課的時候一直打瞌睡。
lines.simplified: 难怪你刚才上课的时候一直打瞌睡。
lines.pinyin: Nánguài nǐ gāngcái shàngkè de shíhòu yìzhí dǎ kēshuì.
lines.english: No wonder you kept nodding off in class just now.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊，連老師叫我回答問題，我都沒聽見。
lines.simplified: 对啊，连老师叫我回答问题，我都没听见。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, lián lǎoshī jiào wǒ huídá wèntí, wǒ dōu méi tīngjiàn.
lines.english: Yes. I didn't even hear the teacher call on me to answer a question.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的說「難怪」，是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的说「难怪」，是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shuō “nánguài”, shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean by 難怪?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de bù yīnggāi jiābān.
choices.english: The woman shouldn't work overtime.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他明白女的為什麼想睡
choices.simplified: 他明白女的为什么想睡
choices.pinyin: Tā míngbái nǚ de wèishénme xiǎng shuì.
choices.english: He understands why she is sleepy.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de shàngkè bú rènzhēn.
choices.english: She doesn't take class seriously.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dìdi de shùxué bù hǎo.
choices.english: Her brother is bad at maths.

questions.why: 難怪 means "no wonder": once he hears she worked late and then helped her brother study, he understands why she kept dozing off. He does not blame her for the overtime or for not caring about class.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳不是說要做一個蛋糕，明天教師節送給老師嗎？
lines.simplified: 你不是说要做一个蛋糕，明天教师节送给老师吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì shuō yào zuò yí ge dàngāo, míngtiān Jiàoshījié sòng gěi lǎoshī ma?
lines.english: Didn't you say you'd bake a cake to give your teacher tomorrow, for Teachers' Day?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 做好了啊。我去洗個手，回來才發現蛋糕已經被狗吃掉一半了。
lines.simplified: 做好了啊。我去洗个手，回来才发现蛋糕已经被狗吃掉一半了。
lines.pinyin: Zuò hǎo le a. Wǒ qù xǐ ge shǒu, huílái cái fāxiàn dàngāo yǐjīng bèi gǒu chī diào yíbàn le.
lines.english: I finished it. I went to wash my hands, and when I came back I found the dog had eaten half the cake.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 那怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Nà zěnme bàn?
lines.english: What will you do?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我只好去樓下的麵包店買一盒餅乾了。
lines.simplified: 我只好去楼下的面包店买一盒饼干了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐhǎo qù lóuxià de miànbāo diàn mǎi yì hé bǐnggān le.
lines.english: I'll just have to buy a box of cookies at the bakery downstairs.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼改送餅乾？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么改送饼干？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme gǎi sòng bǐnggān?
prompt.english: Why is the woman giving cookies instead?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zuò hǎo de dàngāo zhǐ shèng yíbàn.
choices.english: Only half the cake she made is left.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā láibùjí bǎ dàngāo zuò hǎo.
choices.english: She won't finish the cake in time.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老師說想吃麵包店的餅乾
choices.simplified: 老师说想吃面包店的饼干
choices.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō xiǎng chī miànbāo diàn de bǐnggān.
choices.english: The teacher said they wanted cookies from the bakery.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā běnlái zuò de jiù shì bǐnggān.
choices.english: She made cookies to begin with.

questions.why: She finished making the cake for her teacher, but her dog ate half of it. Buying cookies solves the gift problem.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 明天的歷史考試妳準備好了嗎？我上星期生病，三堂課都沒去。
lines.simplified: 明天的历史考试你准备好了吗？我上星期生病，三堂课都没去。
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān de lìshǐ kǎoshì nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma? Wǒ shàng xīngqí shēngbìng, sān táng kè dōu méi qù.
lines.english: Are you ready for tomorrow's history exam? I was ill last week and missed three classes.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這次可難了！老師說古代的政治思想一定會考。
lines.simplified: 这次可难了！老师说古代的政治思想一定会考。
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì kě nán le! Lǎoshī shuō gǔdài de zhèngzhì sīxiǎng yídìng huì kǎo.
lines.english: This one is really hard! The teacher says ancient political thought is sure to come up.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那怎麼辦？妳上課的時候有沒有把老師的話記下來？
lines.simplified: 那怎么办？你上课的时候有没有把老师的话记下来？
lines.pinyin: Nà zěnme bàn? Nǐ shàngkè de shíhòu yǒu méiyǒu bǎ lǎoshī de huà jì xiàlái?
lines.english: What do I do? Did you write down what the teacher said in class?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 有，都在這裡，借你看吧。
lines.simplified: 有，都在这里，借你看吧。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu, dōu zài zhèlǐ, jiè nǐ kàn ba.
lines.english: Yes, it's all here. You can borrow it.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 太好了！我今天晚上看完，明天早上還妳。
lines.simplified: 太好了！我今天晚上看完，明天早上还你。
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ jīntiān wǎnshàng kàn wán, míngtiān zǎoshàng huán nǐ.
lines.english: Great! I'll read it tonight and give it back tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你可別忘了帶來，我考試以前還要再看一遍。
lines.simplified: 你可别忘了带来，我考试以前还要再看一遍。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kě bié wàng le dài lái, wǒ kǎoshì yǐqián hái yào zài kàn yí biàn.
lines.english: Don't you dare forget to bring it. I want to go through it once more before the exam.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 老師說考試會考什麼？
prompt.simplified: 老师说考试会考什么？
prompt.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō kǎoshì huì kǎo shénme?
prompt.english: What does the teacher say the exam will cover?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiànzài de zhèngzhì xīnwén.
choices.english: Political news of today.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gǔdài de lìshǐ gùshì.
choices.english: Stories from ancient history.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shàng xīngqí de zuòyè.
choices.english: Last week's homework.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gǔdài rén duì zhèngzhì de xiǎngfǎ.
choices.english: How people in ancient times thought about politics.

questions.why: The teacher said 古代的政治思想 will come up: ancient political thought, that is, how people in ancient times thought about politics. Not stories and not today's news; last week is only when the man was ill.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後的話是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后的话是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu de huà shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman's last line mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā kǎoshì qián yào ná huí bǐjì.
choices.english: She wants her notes back before the exam.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她今天晚上要跟男的一起複習
choices.simplified: 她今天晚上要跟男的一起复习
choices.pinyin: Tā jīntiān wǎnshàng yào gēn nán de yìqǐ fùxí.
choices.english: She wants to review with him tonight.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她要男的明天早上才看
choices.simplified: 她要男的明天早上才看
choices.pinyin: Tā yào nán de míngtiān zǎoshàng cái kàn.
choices.english: She wants him to start reading tomorrow morning.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yào nán de kǎo wán shì zài huán.
choices.english: She wants him to return the notes after the exam.

questions.why: She lent him her notes and wants them back in time to review them before the exam. He plans to read them tonight.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 剛才兒子的老師打電話來，說他今天在學校推了一個同學。
lines.simplified: 刚才儿子的老师打电话来，说他今天在学校推了一个同学。
lines.pinyin: Gāngcái érzi de lǎoshī dǎ diànhuà lái, shuō tā jīntiān zài xuéxiào tuī le yí ge tóngxué.
lines.english: Our son's teacher just called. She says he pushed a classmate at school today.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他怎麼可以跟別人打架！我現在就去學校找他！
lines.simplified: 他怎么可以跟别人打架！我现在就去学校找他！
lines.pinyin: Tā zěnme kěyǐ gēn biérén dǎjià! Wǒ xiànzài jiù qù xuéxiào zhǎo tā!
lines.english: How can he fight with other kids? I’m going to find him at school right now!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你先別這麼激動。我可不信他會先打人。
lines.simplified: 你先别这么激动。我可不信他会先打人。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bié zhème jīdòng. Wǒ kě bú xìn tā huì xiān dǎ rén.
lines.english: Don’t get so worked up. I really don’t believe he would hit someone first.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那老師還說了什麼？
lines.simplified: 那老师还说了什么？
lines.pinyin: Nà lǎoshī hái shuō le shénme?
lines.english: So what else did the teacher say?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 老師說，是那個同學先指著他說他笨，兩個人才吵起來的。
lines.simplified: 老师说，是那个同学先指着他说他笨，两个人才吵起来的。
lines.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō, shì nàge tóngxué xiān zhǐ zhe tā shuō tā bèn, liǎng ge rén cái chǎo qǐlái de.
lines.english: She said the other boy pointed at him first and called him stupid; that is why the two of them started quarrelling.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好吧。那等他回來，我們先聽聽他怎麼說。
lines.simplified: 好吧。那等他回来，我们先听听他怎么说。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba. Nà děng tā huílái, wǒmen xiān tīngtīng tā zěnme shuō.
lines.english: All right. When he gets home, let's first hear what he says.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的說「我可不信」，是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的说「我可不信」，是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shuō “wǒ kě bú xìn”, shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: The woman says 我可不信. What does she mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她覺得兒子只是跟人吵架
choices.simplified: 她觉得儿子只是跟人吵架
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde érzi zhǐshì gēn rén chǎojià.
choices.english: She thinks her son only argued with someone.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她要男的馬上去問兒子
choices.simplified: 她要男的马上去问儿子
choices.pinyin: Tā yào nán de mǎshàng qù wèn érzi.
choices.english: She wants the man to ask their son at once.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她覺得兒子沒有先動手
choices.simplified: 她觉得儿子没有先动手
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde érzi méiyǒu xiān dòngshǒu.
choices.english: She thinks her son did not start the fight.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde lǎoshī shuō cuò le.
choices.english: She thinks the teacher got it wrong.

questions.why: 可 adds force to 不信. She doubts her son started the fight. She still accepts that he pushed someone.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 聽完女的說的話，男的怎麼改變原來的打算？
prompt.simplified: 听完女的说的话，男的怎么改变原来的打算？
prompt.pinyin: Tīng wán nǚ de shuō de huà, nán de zěnme gǎibiàn yuánlái de dǎsuàn?
prompt.english: How does the man change his plans after hearing what the woman says?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 本來要問老師，現在要問同學
choices.simplified: 本来要问老师，现在要问同学
choices.pinyin: Běnlái yào wèn lǎoshī, xiànzài yào wèn tóngxué.
choices.english: He was going to ask the teacher, but now he'll ask the classmate.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 本來要去學校，現在要等兒子
choices.simplified: 本来要去学校，现在要等儿子
choices.pinyin: Běnlái yào qù xuéxiào, xiànzài yào děng érzi.
choices.english: He was going to the school, but now he'll wait for his son.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 本來要等兒子，現在要找老師
choices.simplified: 本来要等儿子，现在要找老师
choices.pinyin: Běnlái yào děng érzi, xiànzài yào zhǎo lǎoshī.
choices.english: He was going to wait for his son, but now he'll go find the teacher.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 本來要找兒子，現在要找同學
choices.simplified: 本来要找儿子，现在要找同学
choices.pinyin: Běnlái yào zhǎo érzi, xiànzài yào zhǎo tóngxué.
choices.english: He was going to see his son, but now he'll go find the classmate.

questions.why: At first, he wants to go straight to the school. After hearing how the argument started, he decides to hear his son's side when he gets home.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn huà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a short talk, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 大家早安，來看看今天的天氣。
lines.simplified: 大家早安，来看看今天的天气。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā zǎo ān, lái kànkàn jīntiān de tiānqì.
lines.english: Good morning, everyone. Here is today's weather.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 因為北方來的冷空氣，北部今天的溫度只有十五度，感覺比昨天冷了不少，出門記得多穿一件外套。
lines.simplified: 因为北方来的冷空气，北部今天的温度只有十五度，感觉比昨天冷了不少，出门记得多穿一件外套。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi běifāng lái de lěng kōngqì, běibù jīntiān de wēndù zhǐ yǒu shíwǔ dù, gǎnjué bǐ zuótiān lěng le bù shǎo, chūmén jìdé duō chuān yí jiàn wàitào.
lines.english: Because of cold air coming from the north, the temperature in northern Taiwan today is only fifteen degrees. It will feel a good deal colder than yesterday, so remember to wear an extra jacket when you go out.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 中部跟南部比較溫暖，大約二十一度，白天不下雨，感覺很涼快。
lines.simplified: 中部跟南部比较温暖，大约二十一度，白天不下雨，感觉很凉快。
lines.pinyin: Zhōngbù gēn nánbù bǐjiào wēnnuǎn, dàyuē èrshíyī dù, báitiān bú xià yǔ, gǎnjué hěn liángkuài.
lines.english: The center and south are warmer, at around twenty-one degrees. It will stay dry and feel cool during the day.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 北部今天晚上還會下雨，明天早上雨才會停下來，不過明天還是很冷。
lines.simplified: 北部今天晚上还会下雨，明天早上雨才会停下来，不过明天还是很冷。
lines.pinyin: Běibù jīntiān wǎnshàng hái huì xià yǔ, míngtiān zǎoshàng yǔ cái huì tíng xiàlái, búguò míngtiān háishì hěn lěng.
lines.english: The rain in the north will continue tonight and stop tomorrow morning, but it will stay cold all day tomorrow.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個週末台灣各地沒雨，也沒那麼冷，可以帶小朋友到外面走走。
lines.simplified: 这个周末台湾各地没雨，也没那么冷，可以带小朋友到外面走走。
lines.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò Táiwān gèdì méi yǔ, yě méi nàme lěng, kěyǐ dài xiǎopéngyǒu dào wàimiàn zǒuzǒu.
lines.english: It will stay dry and won't be so cold across Taiwan this weekend. You can take the children out for a walk.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 今天北部跟中南部的天氣有什麼不同？
prompt.simplified: 今天北部跟中南部的天气有什么不同？
prompt.pinyin: Jīntiān běibù gēn zhōngnánbù de tiānqì yǒu shénme bùtóng?
prompt.english: How does today's weather in the north differ from the center and south?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 北部比較冷，中南部有雨
choices.simplified: 北部比较冷，中南部有雨
choices.pinyin: Běibù bǐjiào lěng, zhōngnánbù yǒu yǔ.
choices.english: It is colder in the north, with rain in the center and south.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 北部有雨，中南部比較溫暖
choices.simplified: 北部有雨，中南部比较温暖
choices.pinyin: Běibù yǒu yǔ, zhōngnánbù bǐjiào wēnnuǎn.
choices.english: It is rainy in the north and warmer in the center and south.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 北部比較溫暖，中南部沒雨
choices.simplified: 北部比较温暖，中南部没雨
choices.pinyin: Běibù bǐjiào wēnnuǎn, zhōngnánbù méi yǔ.
choices.english: It is warmer in the north, with no rain in the center and south.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 北部沒雨，中南部比較冷
choices.simplified: 北部没雨，中南部比较冷
choices.pinyin: Běibù méi yǔ, zhōngnánbù bǐjiào lěng.
choices.english: It is dry in the north and colder in the center and south.

questions.why: The center and south are warmer at twenty-one degrees and dry during the day. The north is at fifteen degrees and has rain into the evening.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 北部的人想等到不冷也不下雨再帶孩子出門，哪個安排最好？
prompt.simplified: 北部的人想等到不冷也不下雨再带孩子出门，哪个安排最好？
prompt.pinyin: Běibù de rén xiǎng děng dào bù lěng yě bú xià yǔ zài dài háizi chūmén, nǎ ge ānpái zuì hǎo?
prompt.english: A parent in the north wants to take the children out when it is neither cold nor rainy. Which plan is best?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jīntiān báitiān jiù qù zǒuzǒu.
choices.english: Go for a walk during the day today.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshàng zài chūqù zǒuzǒu.
choices.english: Go for a walk tonight.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Míngtiān děng yǔ tíng le jiù qù.
choices.english: Go tomorrow as soon as the rain stops.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Děng zhōumò tiānqì hǎo le zài qù.
choices.english: Wait for better weather this weekend.

questions.why: It rains into tonight and stays cold tomorrow even after the rain stops. The forecast recommends the weekend for taking children out.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段介紹，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段介绍，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn jièshào, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a self-introduction, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 大家好，歡迎來到孔廟。孔廟是紀念孔子的地方，在古代，連君王都要拜孔子。
lines.simplified: 大家好，欢迎来到孔庙。孔庙是纪念孔子的地方，在古代，连君王都要拜孔子。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo, huānyíng lái dào Kǒngmiào. Kǒngmiào shì jìniàn Kǒngzǐ de dìfāng, zài gǔdài, lián jūnwáng dōu yào bài Kǒngzǐ.
lines.english: Hello, everyone, and welcome to the Confucius Temple. The temple honours Confucius; in ancient times even kings worshipped him.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 孔子是中國最偉大的老師，他的教育跟政治思想，到現在還影響著東方很多國家。
lines.simplified: 孔子是中国最伟大的老师，他的教育跟政治思想，到现在还影响着东方很多国家。
lines.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ shì Zhōngguó zuì wěidà de lǎoshī, tā de jiàoyù gēn zhèngzhì sīxiǎng, dào xiànzài hái yǐngxiǎng zhe dōngfāng hěn duō guójiā.
lines.english: Confucius was China's greatest teacher, and his ideas on education and politics still influence many countries in the East today.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這裡也紀念孔子的學生，像是子路。
lines.simplified: 这里也纪念孔子的学生，像是子路。
lines.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yě jìniàn Kǒngzǐ de xuéshēng, xiàng shì Zǐlù.
lines.english: The temple also honors Confucius’s students, including Zilu.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 每年教師節，這裡一早就有很多家長帶孩子來，希望孩子書念得好。
lines.simplified: 每年教师节，这里一早就有很多家长带孩子来，希望孩子书念得好。
lines.pinyin: Měi nián Jiàoshījié, zhèlǐ yì zǎo jiù yǒu hěn duō jiāzhǎng dài háizi lái, xīwàng háizi shū niàn de hǎo.
lines.english: Every year on Teachers' Day, many parents bring their children here first thing in the morning, hoping they will do well at school.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 等一下我們會在大樹下停下來，休息十分鐘，請大家不要走遠。
lines.simplified: 等一下我们会在大树下停下来，休息十分钟，请大家不要走远。
lines.pinyin: Děng yíxià wǒmen huì zài dà shù xià tíng xiàlái, xiūxí shí fēnzhōng, qǐng dàjiā búyào zǒu yuǎn.
lines.english: In a moment we'll stop under the big tree for a ten-minute rest. Please don't wander off.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 教師節帶孩子來孔廟的家長，可能會對孩子說什麼？
prompt.simplified: 教师节带孩子来孔庙的家长，可能会对孩子说什么？
prompt.pinyin: Jiàoshījié dài háizi lái Kǒngmiào de jiāzhǎng, kěnéng huì duì háizi shuō shénme?
prompt.english: What might a parent taking their child to the temple on Teachers' Day say to the child?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīwàng nǐ shàngkè xué de hǎo.
choices.english: I hope you do well at school.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīwàng nǐ zhǎngdà dāng lǎoshī.
choices.english: I hope you become a teacher.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīwàng nǐ xuéhuì jiāo biérén.
choices.english: I hope you learn how to teach others.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīwàng nǐ gèng liǎojiě lìshǐ.
choices.english: I hope you come to understand history better.

questions.why: The speaker connects the visit on Teachers’ Day with parents' hopes for their children's schoolwork. Confucius's work as a teacher and the temple's history are discussed earlier.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 說話的人最可能在做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 说话的人最可能在做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Shuōhuà de rén zuì kěnéng zài zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What is the speaker most likely doing?

choices.speaker: N

text.traditional:
九月二十八日是教師節，也是紀念孔子的節日。圖書館請三位教師介紹孔子和他的思想。每場免費，歡迎對歷史、哲學或教育有興趣的人參加。
九月九日：孔子和他的學生子路，三樓
九月十六日（二樓）：孔子的政治理想——君王為什麼不接受？
九月二十三日：孔子的思想對東方教育的影響，二樓
每場下午兩點開始，一個半小時。每次只有六十個位子，必須在活動開始前進去。三場都聽完的人，最後一場聽完可以拿到一本《孔子的故事》。
圖書館

text.english:
Teachers’ Day, September 28, commemorates Confucius. The library has invited three teachers to introduce him and his ideas. All talks are free. Anyone interested in history, philosophy, or education is welcome.
September 9: Confucius and his student Zilu, third floor
September 16 (second floor): Confucius’s political ideals. Why didn’t rulers accept them?
September 23: How Confucius’s ideas influenced education in the East, second floor

passage.traditional: 上個月，我到鄉下一所小學教畫畫。我帶小朋友到河邊畫橋，看了大家一眼，發現只有一個男孩一直看著{1}。我問他在看什麼。他用手{2}著剛到河邊的船說：「我爸爸下班都坐這條船回家。」船停了，有個人{3}，笑著向我們走來。我這才{4}，男孩一直在等爸爸。男孩{5}地跳了起來，大聲叫爸爸。那天，他畫的不是橋，是剛回家的爸爸。

passage.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè, wǒ dào xiāngxià yì suǒ xiǎoxué jiāo huàhuà. Wǒ dài xiǎopéngyǒu dào hébiān huà qiáo, kàn le dàjiā yì yǎn, fāxiàn zhǐ yǒu yí ge nánhái yìzhí kàn zhe duìmiàn. Wǒ wèn tā zài kàn shénme. Tā yòng shǒu zhǐ zhe gāng dào hébiān de chuán shuō: “Wǒ bàba xiàbān dōu zuò zhè tiáo chuán huí jiā.” Chuán tíng le, yǒu ge rén xià chuán, xiào zhe xiàng wǒmen zǒu lái. Wǒ zhè cái míngbái, nánhái yìzhí zài děng bàba. Nánhái jīdòng de tiào le qǐlái, dà shēng jiào bàba. Nà tiān, tā huà de bú shì qiáo, shì gāng huí jiā de bàba.
passage.english: Last month I taught art at a primary school in the countryside. I took the children to the river to draw the bridge. When I glanced at the group, I noticed that only one boy kept looking across the river. I asked what he was looking at. He pointed at the boat that had just reached the bank. “Dad takes this boat home from work,” he said. The boat stopped, and someone got off and walked toward us with a smile. I finally understood that the boy had been waiting for his dad. The boy jumped up excitedly and called out to him. That day he drew his father coming home instead of the bridge.

Tuìxiū yǐhòu, tā céngjīng xiǎng qù shàngkè, kěshì yìzhí juéde zìjǐ niánjì tài dà, yòu bèn, xué bú huì xīn dōngxi, suǒyǐ yìzhí bù gǎn qù. Hòulái, tā de xiǎo érzi duì tā shuō: “Zhǐyǒu kāishǐ xué, cái zhīdào zìjǐ xué bù xué de huì.” Tā xiǎng le hěn jiǔ, zuìhòu juédìng shìshì kàn.
Bān shàng tóngxué de bèijǐng hé chéngdù bùtóng, lǎoshī cháng yòng shēnghuó zhōng de lìzi jiāo huìhuà. Dàjiā hùxiāng bāngmáng, mànmàn xuéhuì yòng Yīngwén biǎodá zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ. Zhāng yéye měi cì dōu hěn rènzhēn de huídá wèntí, biǎoxiàn bǐ hěn duō niánqīng rén hái hǎo. Tā shuō, zhège jīhuì tā děngdài le wǔshí duō nián, suǒyǐ dào xiànzài měi cì dōu zhǔnshí dào jiàoshì.
text.english:
Grandpa Zhang, who lives across from me, is seventy this year, and last month he started learning English at the community college. He told me his family was very poor when he was a boy, and at twelve he had no choice but to leave school and go to work in a factory. All his life, his greatest hope was to go back to a classroom and study.
After he retired he once thought of taking classes, but he kept thinking he was too old and too stupid to learn anything new, so he never dared to go. Then his youngest son said to him, “Only when you start learning will you know whether you can learn it.” He thought about it for a long time and eventually decided to give it a try.
The students have different backgrounds and levels. The teacher uses examples from daily life to teach conversation. The students help each other and slowly learn to express their ideas in English. Grandpa Zhang always answers questions carefully and does better than many young people. He says he waited more than fifty years for this chance, so he gets to class on time every time.

text.traditional:
我是從德國來的交換學生。剛到台灣的時候，我發現這裡上課跟我在西方的經驗很不一樣。在德國，老師一問問題，大家就馬上說自己的想法，說錯了也沒關係；在這裡，同學大多安靜地把老師的話寫下來，很少有人開口回答。
我曾經以為大家的想法比較保守，後來才明白，很多人有自己的想法，只是怕說錯了，別人會笑。現在我們的老師常常先讓大家三、四個人一起討論，再請同學向大家說明自己的想法。大家很快就接受了這個方法，表現也比我想的好得多。
我覺得東方和西方的教育都有好的地方，任何一種教法都不會永遠有用。教師可以看學生的背景和程度，改變上課的方式。
text.simplified:

我曾经以为大家的想法比较保守，后来才明白，很多人有自己的想法，只是怕说错了，别人会笑。现在我们的老师常常先让大家三、四个人一起讨论，再请同学向大家说明自己的想法。大家很快就接受了这个方法，表现也比我想的好得多。
我觉得东方和西方的教育都有好的地方，任何一种教法都不会永远有用。教师可以看学生的背景和程度，改变上课的方式。

Wǒ shì cóng Déguó lái de jiāohuàn xuéshēng. Gāng dào Táiwān de shíhòu, wǒ fāxiàn zhèlǐ shàngkè gēn wǒ zài xīfāng de jīngyàn hěn bù yíyàng. Zài Déguó, lǎoshī yí wèn wèntí, dàjiā jiù mǎshàng shuō zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ, shuō cuò le yě méiguānxi; zài zhèlǐ, tóngxué dàduō ānjìng de bǎ lǎoshī de huà xiě xiàlái, hěn shǎo yǒu rén kāikǒu huídá.
Wǒ céngjīng yǐwéi dàjiā de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào bǎoshǒu, hòulái cái míngbái, hěn duō rén yǒu zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ, zhǐshì pà shuō cuò le, biérén huì xiào. Xiànzài wǒmen de lǎoshī chángcháng xiān ràng dàjiā sān, sì ge rén yìqǐ tǎolùn, zài qǐng tóngxué xiàng dàjiā shuōmíng zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ. Dàjiā hěn kuài jiù jiēshòu le zhège fāngfǎ, biǎoxiàn yě bǐ wǒ xiǎng de hǎo de duō.
Wǒ juéde dōngfāng hé xīfāng de jiàoyù dōu yǒu hǎo de dìfāng, rènhé yì zhǒng jiāofǎ dōu bú huì yǒngyuǎn yǒuyòng. Jiàoshī kěyǐ kàn xuéshēng de bèijǐng hé chéngdù, gǎibiàn shàngkè de fāngshì.
text.english:
I am an exchange student from Germany. When I first arrived in Taiwan, I found classes here very different from my experience in the West. In Germany, as soon as the teacher asks a question, everyone says what they think straight away, and it doesn't matter if they get it wrong; here, most classmates quietly write down what the teacher says, and few people speak up to answer.
I once thought people's ideas here were rather conservative, but later I understood that many people have ideas of their own. They just worry others will laugh if they get something wrong. Now our teacher often has us discuss in groups of three or four first, and then asks them to explain their ideas to the class. Everyone quickly took to this method, and they do far better than I expected.
I think education in both the East and the West has its good points; no teaching method works in every situation forever. Teachers can change how they teach based on their students’ backgrounds and levels.

除夕前一天，公司通知我們晚上還要加班。我本來打算留在台北。下班後，媽媽打電話給我。她說：「你以前不是想學煎蘿蔔糕嗎？明天回來，我教你。」我改坐除夕早上的高鐵回南部。
媽媽在廚房裡準備年夜飯。媽媽說，她跟爸爸結婚以後，就跟奶奶學會了做蘿蔔糕，以前都是奶奶一個人做。這幾年奶奶的手常常痛，現在是媽媽負責這一部分。她叫我先用小火煎一塊。等我學會了，才讓我煎給家人吃。
吃年夜飯的時候，奶奶吃了一口，笑著說：「我從來沒吃過你做的蘿蔔糕，今天可吃到了！」要不是媽媽打來，我大概還在台北呢。
text.simplified:

妈妈在厨房里准备年夜饭。妈妈说，她跟爸爸结婚以后，就跟奶奶学会了做萝卜糕，以前都是奶奶一个人做。这几年奶奶的手常常痛，现在是妈妈负责这一部分。她叫我先用小火煎一块。等我学会了，才让我煎给家人吃。
吃年夜饭的时候，奶奶吃了一口，笑着说：「我从来没吃过你做的萝卜糕，今天可吃到了！」要不是妈妈打来，我大概还在台北呢。
text.pinyin:
Chúxì qián yì tiān, gōngsī tōngzhī wǒmen wǎnshàng hái yào jiābān. Wǒ běnlái dǎsuàn liú zài Táiběi. Xiàbān hòu, māma dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ. Tā shuō: “Nǐ yǐqián bú shì xiǎng xué jiān luóbogāo ma? Míngtiān huílái, wǒ jiāo nǐ.” Wǒ gǎi zuò chúxì zǎoshàng de gāotiě huí nánbù.
Māma zài chúfáng lǐ zhǔnbèi niányèfàn. Māma shuō, tā gēn bàba jiéhūn yǐhòu, jiù gēn nǎinai xuéhuì le zuò luóbogāo, yǐqián dōu shì nǎinai yí ge rén zuò. Zhè jǐ nián nǎinai de shǒu chángcháng tòng, xiànzài shì māma fùzé zhè yí bùfen. Tā jiào wǒ xiān yòng xiǎo huǒ jiān yí kuài. Děng wǒ xuéhuì le, cái ràng wǒ jiān gěi jiārén chī.
Chī niányèfàn de shíhòu, nǎinai chī le yì kǒu, xiào zhe shuō: “Wǒ cónglái méi chī guo nǐ zuò de luóbogāo, jīntiān kě chī dào le!” Yàobúshì māma dǎ lái, wǒ dàgài hái zài Táiběi ne.
text.english:
The day before Lunar New Year’s Eve, the company told us we had to work overtime that evening. I had planned to stay in Taipei. After work my mother called. “Haven’t you been wanting to learn to pan-fry radish cake? Come home tomorrow and I’ll teach you.” I changed my plans and took the high-speed train south the next morning.
My mother was getting New Year’s Eve dinner ready in the kitchen. She said Grandma taught her to make radish cake after she married my father. Grandma used to do it herself. Her hands have often hurt these past few years, so my mother now takes care of that part. She had me fry one piece over low heat first. Once I got the hang of it, she let me cook for the family.
At dinner Grandma took a bite and smiled. “I’d never had radish cake made by you before. Today I finally got to try it!” If my mother hadn’t called, I’d probably still be in Taipei.

text.traditional:
大一的時候，我對好幾個社團都感興趣，一下子就參加了四個。下課後，有時得去學吉他，有時得去打籃球。我連功課都來不及寫，考試成績也越來越差。
一位大三的同學看出我有煩惱，問我平常怎麼安排時間。我說，四個社團的活動我都想去。他告訴我，自己以前也遇到過這種情況，後來發現光是上課就很忙。他說：「每個社團都去，不如只留下你最喜歡的一個。」我想了幾天，決定只留在吉他社。
現在我有時間複習功課，也可以跟社員互相學習。上個月，我還跟他們一起上台表演。原來少參加幾個社團，收穫比以前更多。
text.simplified:
大一的时候，我对好几个社团都感兴趣，一下子就参加了四个。下课后，有时得去学吉他，有时得去打篮球。我连功课都来不及写，考试成绩也越来越差。
一位大三的同学看出我有烦恼，问我平常怎么安排时间。我说，四个社团的活动我都想去。他告诉我，自己以前也遇到过这种情况，后来发现光是上课就很忙。他说：「每个社团都去，不如只留下你最喜欢的一个。」我想了几天，决定只留在吉他社。
现在我有时间复习功课，也可以跟社员互相学习。上个月，我还跟他们一起上台表演。原来少参加几个社团，收获比以前更多。
text.pinyin:
Dà yī de shíhòu, wǒ duì hǎo jǐ ge shètuán dōu gǎn xìngqù, yíxiàzi jiù cānjiā le sì ge. Xiàkè hòu, yǒushí děi qù xué jítā, yǒushí děi qù dǎ lánqiú. Wǒ lián gōngkè dōu láibùjí xiě, kǎoshì chéngjī yě yuè lái yuè chà.
Yí wèi dà sān de tóngxué kàn chū wǒ yǒu fánnǎo, wèn wǒ píngcháng zěnme ānpái shíjiān. Wǒ shuō, sì ge shètuán de huódòng wǒ dōu xiǎng qù. Tā gàosù wǒ, zìjǐ yǐqián yě yùdào guo zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng, hòulái fāxiàn guāng shì shàngkè jiù hěn máng. Tā shuō: “Měi ge shètuán dōu qù, bùrú zhǐ liú xià nǐ zuì xǐhuān de yí ge.” Wǒ xiǎng le jǐ tiān, juédìng zhǐ liú zài jítā shè.
Xiànzài wǒ yǒu shíjiān fùxí gōngkè, yě kěyǐ gēn shèyuán hùxiāng xuéxí. Shàng ge yuè, wǒ hái gēn tāmen yìqǐ shàng tái biǎoyǎn. Yuánlái shǎo cānjiā jǐ ge shètuán, shōuhuò bǐ yǐqián gèng duō.
text.english:
In my first year of university I was interested in several clubs and joined four straight away. After class I sometimes had to go play guitar and sometimes had to play basketball. I didn’t even have time for my homework, and my grades got worse and worse.
A third-year student noticed I was worried and asked how I usually planned my time. I said I wanted to attend all four clubs’ activities. He had been in the same situation and had found that classes alone kept him quite busy. “Instead of going to every club, you’d be better off staying in just your favorite one,” he said. I thought about it for a few days and decided to stay in the guitar club alone.
Now I have time to review my schoolwork and learn with the other members. Last month I even performed onstage with them. It turns out that I got more out of joining fewer clubs.
